description: Return tier-based lead-time guidance for an event date and configured market. Use for 'What's the typical lead time for brand ambassadors in [city]?' or 'Is this date inside the usual planning window?'. This is not a real-time inventory or order-coverage check: a TempGuru coordinator confirms coverage and final lead time for the specific order after buyer submission. DO NOT use for cost questions (use get_role_pricing) and never present the result as a reservation. <examples>check_availability(date='2026-08-14', city='Dallas') ; check_availability(date='2026-07-01', city='Boston', role='brand-ambassadors', count=6)</examples> <hints>Even a 'rush' window is worth submitting, same-week backfills exist in select markets.</hints>

date.description: Event date as YYYY-MM-DD; legacy recognizable dates are still accepted.

role.description: Optional role name or slug to include rate context.

name: check_availability

city_found.description: false = city did not match the configured catalog (see message); true = planning guidance below, not confirmed coverage.

city_tier.description: Market tier: hub = 25 major metros, mid = 128 secondary markets, small = 192 tertiary markets.

error.description: Present when the date could not be parsed.

in_past.description: True when the requested date is already in the past — confirm the date before planning.

recommendation.description: Lead-time guidance, NOT a reservation. Even rush is worth submitting.

requested.description: Echo of the unmatched city input.

rate_range_usd.description: All-inclusive hourly rate band (worker pay + payroll taxes + workers comp + liability).

high.description: Upper end of the hourly rate range.

low.description: Lower end of the hourly rate range.

role.description: Rate context when a role was provided; null otherwise.

role_found.description: null = no role requested; false = the requested role didn't match the catalog (see notes).

role_suggestion.description: Closest known city/role for a miss. Confirm with the user before using it; do not auto-apply.

suggestion.description: Closest known city/role for a miss. Confirm with the user before using it; do not auto-apply.
